item.title: Implement specified rate limiter in ratelimit.py
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, whose module currently contains stubs. Follow the specification exactly, including every documented error case and edge case; tests in test_ratelimit.py cover only basics. Keep the implementation dependency-free using only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests/checks, ensure spec edge cases are addressed, and commit the finished work. Acceptance: behavior matches SPEC.md, existing tests pass, no non-standard dependencies are added, and the implementation is committed.

pr.body: Implemented in ratelimit.py using only the Python standard library. TokenBucket supports fractional continuous refill, bounded availability, non-consuming wait estimates, and backward-clock protection. KeyedLimiter tracks independent buckets and evicts least-recently-used keys on both acquisition and wait calls. Validation rejects non-positive and non-finite configuration/request values. Checks: unittest (3 passed), compileall, diff check, and focused edge probes all passed. Initial baseline: all 3 tests errored because implementation methods were stubs. Independent review found and the follow-up review confirmed the NaN fix.
pr.summary: Implemented token bucket and keyed LRU rate limiting. Before: both classes were stubs and all existing tests errored. Now: configured limits, refill/wait behavior, and key eviction work as specified, with invalid and non-finite values rejected.
